text:
Sam (AE): FinRegCo follow-up: they need strict EU-only handling for a 10-day POC. Questions on subnet/eIP and subprocessors.
FinRegCo - Bob: We need a single egress IP to whitelist, BYOK (Azure KV), and a subprocessors snapshot. Security review Friday.
Priya (SE): Tech notes: we can tenant-pin to eu-west-1, KV references only (we don’t import plaintext), model variants available in region. Logs can be kept in-region; need to confirm which exporters are enabled.
Marco (Ops): Ops options: (1) whitelist our EU egress CIDR (no tenant static IP), (2) temporary dedicated NAT eIP for the tenant (one-time setup + hourly allocation). For short POC we recommend temp NAT for easiest customer firewall config.
Nina (Legal): I'll prepare an attestation listing subprocessors for eu-west-1 and confirm log retention controls.
customer-bot: Reminder: security board slot at 1500 UTC Friday.
Priya (SE): BYOK sample: provide key reference URL, grant Redwood role access, we reference via API. No plaintext key in control plane.
Marco (Ops): Opening ticket OPS-8021 to allocate eIP. ETA 6 hours for IP list. Setup fee estimate ~$400 (TBD). Revoke/teardown ~20-40m ops.
Sam (AE): Pricing: include (A) standard POC w/ CIDR whitelist (no setup fee) (B) POC w/ dedicated eIP (one-time setup + hourly). I'll scope both.
FinRegCo - Bob: Please confirm rollback SLA if residency breach occurs and a contact for incident response.
Priya (SE): If we ever detect cross-region egress we can fail closed to the customer tenant and notify ops; typical RTO in POC is <1h.
Sam (AE): Action items: Marco to post IP/CIDR and ops ticket link; Priya to post BYOK + log-touch services; Nina to post attestation draft; AE to send quote.
Marco (Ops): Ticket OPS-8021 created, will update with IPs.
Sam (AE): Thanks — will deliver quote before EOD for security board.
